messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — planning the public release announcement for v1.8 on Wed 2026-04-02. Need final changelog entry, docs link, benchmark narrative, webinar timing, and inbound lead routing details. TL;DR: marketing needs everything by EOD Mon.

rachel_pm: tagging @sam_eng for changelog and rollout timing. @micaela_docs for docs links. @josh_growth for benchmark narrative and webinar lead.

sam_eng: I'll drop the changelog PR today. Link when ready. Canary plan idea: Tue 2026-03-31 14:00 PT start, 2-hour stagger, 10% traffic initial, fallback to v1.7. Canary id: canary-482.

sam_eng: Notes on rollout: route name is `inference/v1.8`; we need marketing to avoid calling it a breaking change — it's a perf/quality improvement with a minor API opt-in.

micaela_docs: Docs PR in flight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/915. Will add a short "what's new" section and a migration how-to. Final public URL will likely be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.8 (confirm after merge).

josh_growth: Benchmark narrative draft: reduced 95th latency by ~18% and ~22% token-cost savings on steady-state throughput (p4d). I'll post a 3-bullet blurb + 2 graphs to Drive by EOD. Prefer anonymized customer scenarios (SaaS workload and dedicated infra).

josh_growth: Question — do we want absolute numbers or percent changes in the public blog? I prefer percent + representative numbers to avoid token-level cost exposure.

rachel_pm: Percent + representative numbers works. Avoid per-token pricing or internal telemetry screenshots. Use anonymized workload descriptions.

sam_eng: Agreed — also, please don't publish absolute per-token cost from internal telemetry. For safety, use phrasing like "up to 22% lower token cost in benchmarked workloads" and include test config in an appendix (sequence length, batch, model config).

alex_m: Webinar proposal: Wed 2026-04-09 10:00 PT. Panel: rachel (pm), sam (eng), josh (growth). Marketing to own registration page + lead routing. Can we run a short demo and a Q&A?

josh_growth: I'll set up registration + form. Need two-sentence bios for speakers, a 1-line session description, and a 1-paragraph blurb for the landing page. Also need a CTA for post-webinar follow-up (demo vs trial vs dedicated eval).

micaela_docs: I'll prepare a short migration snippet for the docs. Example snippet for the how-to: ```\n# rolling pin upgrade\nrictl set-model --name inference-v1.8 --route canary --weight 10\n```

sam_eng: That snippet's good. Also adding a sample canary verification check to docs (latency percentiles and error rate thresholds).

oncall-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-31 14:00 PT. Reminder set for 30 minutes before.

rachel_pm: Marketing asks checklist (please confirm by EOD Mon): 1) final changelog line (single sentence) 2) merged docs link 3) benchmark 3-bullet summary + graphs 4) canary start time + id 5) hero screenshot or GIF 6) PRs to mention in credits 7) preferred embargo/embargo lift time.

sam_eng: Confirmed — I'll deliver changelog sentence, canary id, screenshot (png), and PR links. Docs PR should merge after a small lint fix; ETA EOD Mon.

josh_growth: I'll deliver benchmark blurb + Drive link to graphs and set up registration page. For lead routing, default to growth-sdrs@redwood.ai — can override per account if known.

alex_m: Perfect. Marketing will assemble the announce post, schedule embargoed publish Wed after canary green. Thanks all — will post the assembled draft here for final sign-off. :rocket:
